cards.name: current-youtube-image-sizes
cards.title: Current YouTube Image Sizes and Specs

groups.label: Profile picture: 800×800
groups.text: YouTube recommends uploading a square profile picture at 800×800 pixels.

groups.label: Channel banner: 2560×1440
groups.text: The banner preset outputs 2560×1440, the size YouTube asks for.

groups.label: What you can upload
groups.text: The resizer opens any image your browser can read.

groups.label: What you can download
groups.text: Every preset downloads as PNG or JPG, your choice.

groups.label: File size
groups.text: The resizer has no upload limit of its own, because nothing is uploaded.

cards.name: how-to
cards.title: How to Use the YouTube Image Resizer

steps.title: Choose your image
steps.text: Click the upload area or drop a JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF onto it.

steps.title: Pick a format
steps.text: PNG is lossless and best for logos, text and flat graphics.

cards.name: use-cases
cards.title: Who the YouTube Image Resizer Is For

groups.label: New YouTubers setting up a channel
groups.text: Starting a channel means making a profile picture.

groups.label: Creators who upload every week
groups.text: If you make thumbnails in a design app at the wrong size.

groups.label: Small businesses and local shops
groups.text: A bakery, salon or gym often uses its existing logo as the profile picture.
